title: Large-charge ADHM-BMN index matching
summary: We compare the superconformal index of three-dimensional ADHM theory in fixed monopole sectors with the index of the BMN matrix model around fuzzy-sphere vacua. The monopole charges determine the sizes of the fuzzy-sphere blocks, and their multiplicities determine how many identical blocks occur. At a fixed number of fundamental hypermultiplets, we increase all positive monopole charges by the same amount while keeping their differences and multiplicities fixed.
